makemeahanzi.definition: to scare, to frighten; to threaten, to intimidate

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 吓 relates to a shout or cry, as when someone is frightened.
下 (xià) gives the sound — an exact match with 吓.

makemeahanzi.definition: border, edge, margin, side

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (walking/movement) — links 边's meaning to a boundary or edge one moves along.
臱 (biān) gives the sound — 边 is also pronounced biān, an exact match.

makemeahanzi.definition: pair, couple; both; measure word for things that come in pairs

characterDeckComponents.note: 又 (hand), doubled — two hands side by side depict a pair, giving 双 its meaning 'pair, both, two.'

meanings: in a confused state of mind

makemeahanzi.definition: anarchy, chaos; revolt
phrase, expression; words, speech

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 词 names a word, a unit of speech.
司 (sī) gives the sound — an exact match with 词.

makemeahanzi.definition: you; that, those; final particle
to jump over, to leap over; to overtake, to surpass

characterDeckComponents.note: 走 (to walk/run) — 超 relates to overtaking or surpassing someone while moving
召 (zhào) gives a sound distantly related to 超's reading chāo, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: to support, to sustain; to withdraw, to pay; a branch (of a bank)

etymology.hint: A hand 又 holding a branch 十 for support

characterDeckComponents.note: 又 (a hand) — reaching out for support.
十 (a branch) — held in the hand, the image of support giving 支 its meaning 'to support, prop up; branch.'

makemeahanzi.definition: pen, pencil, writing brush; to compose, to write; Hanzi stroke

etymology.hint: A bamboo rod ⺮ tipped with hair 毛

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) depicts the shaft of a writing brush.
毛 (hair) depicts the bristled tip of the brush — together giving 笔 its meaning 'writing brush, pen.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to fill; full, packed; satisfied

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — relates to 满's meaning 'full,' water filling to the brim.
㒼 (mán) gives a sound hint — 满 is pronounced mǎn, sharing the same base sound with a different tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: fake, false, deceitful; vacation

etymology.hint: A false 叚 person 亻; 叚 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — represents a human figure.

叚 depicts borrowing or handing something over — a person who is not genuine, or something borrowed rather than real, gave 假 its meaning 'false, fake' (and, for a break from routine, 'vacation, leave.')

makemeahanzi.definition: to collect, to gather, to harvest

characterDeckComponents.note: 攵 (a hand with an implement) — relates to 收's meaning 'to receive, collect, harvest.'
丩 (jiū) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from shōu.

makemeahanzi.definition: to smash, to pound, to crush, to break

characterDeckComponents.note: 石 (rock) — 砸 involves a hard, crushing impact.
匝 (zā) gives a sound close to zá, differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: street, road, thoroughfare

characterDeckComponents.note: 行 (to go/walk) — 街 names a road where people walk and travel.
圭 (guī) gives a sound distantly related to jiē, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: area, district, region, ward; surname

etymology.hint: A place 匸 under a lord's control 乂

characterDeckComponents.note: 匸 (an enclosure or boundary) — 区 pictures a defined territory.
乂 (a mark, here representing control or division) — dividing land into bounded territories gave 区 its meaning 'district' or 'area.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to bump into, to collide, to hit, to knock against

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 撞 describes striking or bumping into something with force.
童 (tóng) is only distantly related in sound to zhuàng — the connection has drifted apart over time.

meanings: (used in combination with 給|给[gei3] or 出[chu1] etc) to lend

makemeahanzi.definition: to borrow; to lend; excuse, pretext

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 借 describes an action between people, lending or borrowing.
昔 (xī) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading jiè has diverged considerably.

makemeahanzi.definition: a second; a corn kernel; measure word for time

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain) — 秒 originally named the delicate beard of a grain stalk.
少 (shǎo) gives a sound moderately close to miǎo, sharing the rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: to carry, to haul, to transport

characterDeckComponents.note: 车 (cart) — 输 originally meant to transport goods by cart.
俞 (yú) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading shū has diverged.

makemeahanzi.definition: seat; stand, base

etymology.hint: A wide 广 seat 坐; 坐 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 广 (a wide, open building) — a hall or pavilion
坐 (to sit) — a seat placed inside the building

makemeahanzi.definition: to affect, to move, to touch; to perceive, to sense

etymology.hint: Two hearts 心 beating together 咸

characterDeckComponents.note: 咸 (all, together) — 感 relates to a shared reaction.
心 (heart) — feelings that stir the heart gave 感 its meaning 'to feel' or 'emotion.'

makemeahanzi.definition: his, her, its, their; that
to dislike, to hate, to resent

characterDeckComponents.note: 忄 (heart/mind) — 恨 describes a strong feeling in the heart, hatred.
艮 (gèn) gives a sound close to hèn.

makemeahanzi.definition: to take off, to shed; to escape from

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh, body) — 脱 relates to taking something off the body.
兑 (duì) gives a sound close to tuō, sharing a related initial.

makemeahanzi.definition: to accompany, to be with, to keep company

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (mound, place) shows 陪 relates to being present alongside someone somewhere.
咅 gives a sound distantly related to péi, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: rice, millet, grain

characterDeckComponents.note: 米 depicts scattered grains of husked rice around a central stalk — a simple picture giving 米 its meaning 'rice, grain.'

meanings: (bound form) Afghanistan (abbr. for 阿富汗[A1 fu4 han4])
(bound form) Argentina (abbr. for 阿根廷[A1 gen1 ting2])

makemeahanzi.definition: an initial particle, a prefix used for names; used in transliterations

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (a mound/place) — reflects 阿's original meaning related to a hill or slope
可 (kě) gives a sound close to 阿's reading ā

makemeahanzi.definition: to own; to host; master; host; lord

etymology.hint: A lamp 王 with a flame 丶

characterDeckComponents.note: 丶 (a dot) — represents the burning flame atop a lamp.
王 here depicts the base and stand of an oil lamp, not its usual meaning 'king' — the one who tends the flame became linked to 'master, lord, main.'

makemeahanzi.definition: heat, fever, zeal

characterDeckComponents.note: 灬 (fire) — 热 relates directly to heat
执 (zhí) gives a loose sound connection to 热's reading rè

makemeahanzi.definition: difference, gap; almost, nearly; in error; an officer

etymology.hint: Work 工 done by a sheep 羊; incompetence

characterDeckComponents.note: 羊 (sheep) — work involving livestock, done imperfectly
工 (work) — the labor itself, linked to the idea of falling short

meanings: (when used before a noun of location) furthest or extreme
to be within the limits of

makemeahanzi.definition: to exhaust, to use up, to deplete
island

etymology.hint: A bird 鸟 perched atop a mountain 山

characterDeckComponents.note: 鸟 (a bird) — a bird resting
山 (a mountain) — the mountain peak the bird perches on, rising from the sea

makemeahanzi.definition: hungry; greedy

etymology.hint: To want 我 food 饣; 我 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 饣 (food) — 饿 relates to a need for food.
我 (I, self) suggests personal want or need — paired with food, giving 饿 its meaning 'hungry.'

meanings: used in 女紅|女红[nu : 3 gong1]

makemeahanzi.definition: red, vermillion; to blush, to flush; popular

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (silk/thread) — 红 originally described a color of dyed silk, hence 'red'
工 (gōng) gives a loose sound connection to 红's reading hóng

makemeahanzi.definition: chicken

etymology.hint: Another 又 kind of bird 鸟

characterDeckComponents.note: 又 (hand, here standing in for 奚, part of the original character) — a simplified stroke that no longer pictures anything on its own.
鸟 (bird) — combined with the simplified left side, 鸡 names a specific 'kind of bird,' the chicken.

makemeahanzi.definition: to raise, to rear, to bring up; to support

characterDeckComponents.note: 儿 (child) — 养 relates to raising and nurturing children or animals
羊 (yáng) gives a sound close to 养's reading yǎng, sharing a similar historical pronunciation

makemeahanzi.definition: to pursue, to chase after; to expel

characterDeckComponents.note: 辶 (to walk) — 追 relates to moving in pursuit of someone or something
㠯 (yǐ) gives a sound distantly related to 追's reading zhuī, having drifted apart over time

meanings: (bound form) (of flowers, leaves etc) to wither

makemeahanzi.definition: to thank; to refuse politely

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 谢 describes an act of speaking, giving thanks.
射 (shè) gives the sound — an exact match with 谢.

makemeahanzi.definition: group, crowd; multitude, mob

characterDeckComponents.note: 羊 (sheep) — 群 relates to a group or flock, as sheep gather in a flock
君 (jūn) gives a loose sound connection to 群's reading qún

makemeahanzi.definition: cause, reason; by; because

meanings: to weigh in a balance or on a scale

makemeahanzi.definition: treaty, covenant, agreement

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 约 originally meant 'to bind, tie up,' extending to 'to agree, arrange' and 'approximately.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to pursue, to overtake; to hurry; to expel

characterDeckComponents.note: 走 (to walk, to run) — 赶 relates to pursuing or hurrying, both forms of movement.
干 (gān) gives a rhyme close to gǎn, with the tone shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: slowly, leisurely; sluggish

characterDeckComponents.note: 忄 (heart) — 慢 describes an unhurried state of mind or pace.
曼 (màn) gives the sound — an exact match with 慢.

meanings: (bound form) (military) mine, as in 地雷[di4 lei2] land mine

makemeahanzi.definition: thunder; surname

etymology.hint: A storm 雨 over the fields 田

characterDeckComponents.note: 雨 (rain/storm) — the storm cloud that produces thunder
田 (fields) — the fields the storm rumbles over

makemeahanzi.definition: to burn, to bake; to heat, to roast

characterDeckComponents.note: 火 (fire) — 烧 describes burning or cooking with fire.
尧 (yáo) gives a rhyme close to shāo, with a different initial.

makemeahanzi.definition: to break, to rout; to ruin, to destroy

characterDeckComponents.note: 石 (rock/stone) — 破 relates to breaking, as a rock can be broken
皮 (pí) gives a loose sound connection to 破's reading pò

makemeahanzi.definition: clean, pure; clear, distinct; peaceful

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — relates to 清's meaning 'clear (water), pure.'
青 (qīng) gives the sound — 清 is also pronounced qīng, an exact match.

makemeahanzi.definition: night, dark; under cover of night

etymology.hint: A person 亻 sneaking by under cover 亠 of night 夕

characterDeckComponents.note: 夕 (evening/night) — the darkness that has fallen
亻 (a person) — someone moving under cover of night

makemeahanzi.definition: to perform, to act, to put on a play

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 演 originally described water flowing and spreading out, later extended to 'developing, unfolding'
寅 (yín) gives a sound distantly related to 演's reading yǎn, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: Buddhist nun; used in transliterations
